personality_one_liner: A trustworthy, clean, and unobtrusive health companion that protects your eyes while seamlessly integrating into daily mobile usage.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room. Cards should never be flush to the screen edge; always use md or lg margin. Group related elements tightly and separate groups with larger spacing.

do's: The too-close warning modal overlay (heavily blurred and tinted)

screens.name: Onboarding
screens.purpose: Educate the user about eye strain and set up camera permissions and base distance.
screens.layout: Full-bleed imagery at the top with a gradient scrim (top-to-bottom) blending into the surface color. Bottom 40% contains a large display title, descriptive text, and a sticky primary CTA at the bottom.

screens.name: Home Dashboard
screens.purpose: Provide a quick overview of today's eye-protection stats and quick links to apps/videos.

states.empty: Empty state illustration if no usage logged
states.error: Error message if stats fail to load

screens.layout: Header with greeting. Top section: Large summary card showing 'Active Protection' status and a daily goal ring. Middle section: 'Quick Links' grid (2-col or 4-col icon grid) for YouTube, Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, and Local Player. Bottom section: A horizontal scroll or list of recent streaks/achievements. Sticky bottom tab bar (glass).

screens.name: Web/Video Player
screens.purpose: In-app browser or local video player wrapped with distance monitoring.

states.loading: Progress bar for WebView or spinner for video buffer
states.error: Failed to load URL error with retry button

screens.layout: Full screen content (WebView or Video). A small, floating glass badge at the top safe area indicating 'Protection Active'. When distance is too close, a full-screen absolute overlay with heavy blur and a warning message fades in over this screen.

screens.name: Stats
screens.purpose: Show weekly charts, close-time counts, and streaks.

states.empty: No data illustration 'Start using EyeGuard to see stats'

screens.layout: ScrollView. Segmented control at the top (Day/Week). Main chart card showing screen distance trends. Below: Cards detailing 'Times too close' and 'Current Streak'. Use surfaceSecondary for cards with md margin.

screens.name: Settings & Child Mode
screens.purpose: Configure distance range slider, alert preferences, and manage Child Mode PIN.
screens.layout: List-based settings layout. Tonal icon containers on the left of each row. The distance range slider (15-60cm) is prominently displayed in a card. A distinct section for 'Child Mode' with a toggle and PIN setup button.

screens.name: Child Mode Dashboard
screens.purpose: A simplified, locked-down version of the Home Dashboard for kids.
screens.layout: No bottom tabs. Large, chunky icons for approved apps only. A persistent 'Exit' button at the top right that requires a PIN (Parental Gate). The distance warning is more playful but strict.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use 'iOS-Native Clean' guidelines. The UI should be highly legible, spacious, and utilitarian but warm (using the Sage Green brand color).

For the 'Too Close' distance warning, implement an absolute positioned full-screen modal using 'expo-blur'. It must completely obscure the content beneath it to protect the eyes, pausing any playing video/audio if possible.
The Home Dashboard should use a 2-col or 4-col compact grid for the 'Quick Links' (WebView shortcuts) to keep them highly accessible without cluttering the screen.

Child Mode requires a dual-interface architecture. When enabled, replace the main navigation with a simplified locked-down screen that removes stats/settings and only shows approved apps, secured by a PIN gate.
Use 'react-native-webview' for the in-app social media browsing so the distance monitoring overlay can reliably render over the content.
Ensure the front-camera distance monitoring logic runs efficiently and uses haptics (notificationError) + sound when the threshold is breached.
Include a horizontal slider component for distance configuration (15-60cm) with 5cm step snaps, utilizing 'selection' haptics on each tick.
